notes.title: Update July 21, 2024
notes.content:
You can now aim on all weapons
Increased the maximum number of decals (bullet marks) to 60
Minor fixes

notes.title: Minor fixes on December 28, 2023
notes.content:
Fixed minor errors with incorrect text formatting in some languages
You can also exit the inventory by clicking on Escape
Many other small fixes

notes.title: Small fix
notes.content: Fixed incorrect display of the image in the letter description in some languages.
